findings.title: The concurrency test does not wait for the reader thread
findings.body: The test sets `deletedAll` and immediately asserts on `caughtExceptions` without joining the reader thread. The reader may still be handling an in-flight request, so an exception from the concurrent access can arrive after the assertion and the test can pass falsely; the thread can also continue using the realm after test teardown. Wait for the reader to terminate before asserting, and ensure it is stopped even if deletion fails.
